in_sanskrit.name: Asnish
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord of wisdom
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Asnish एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from Sanskrit words ‘as’ (Lord) and ‘nish’ (wisdom). This name is attributed to Lord Ganesha, the deity of wisdom and knowledge.

in_hindi.name: Asnish
in_hindi.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord of wisdom
in_hindi.long_meaning: Asnish एक हिंदू नाम है जो भारतीय संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from Sanskrit words ‘as’ (Lord) and ‘nish’ (wisdom). This name is attributed to Lord Ganesha, the deity of wisdom and knowledge.

in_tamil.name: Asnish
in_tamil.meaning: இந்து பெயர் என்று பொருள் Lord of wisdom
in_tamil.long_meaning: Asnish ஒரு இந்து பெயர் ஆகும், இது இந்திய கலாச்சாரத்தில் ஆழமான ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவத்தைக் கொண்டுள்ளது। Derived from Sanskrit words ‘as’ (Lord) and ‘nish’ (wisdom). This name is attributed to Lord Ganesha, the deity of wisdom and knowledge.

in_telugu.name: Asnish
in_telugu.meaning: హిందూ పేరు అంటే Lord of wisdom
in_telugu.long_meaning: Asnish ఒక హిందూ పేరు, ఇది భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో లోతైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాముఖ్యతను కలిగి ఉంది। Derived from Sanskrit words ‘as’ (Lord) and ‘nish’ (wisdom). This name is attributed to Lord Ganesha, the deity of wisdom and knowledge.

in_marathi.name: Asnish
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of wisdom
in_marathi.long_meaning: Asnish हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from Sanskrit words ‘as’ (Lord) and ‘nish’ (wisdom). This name is attributed to Lord Ganesha, the deity of wisdom and knowledge.

in_bengali.name: Asnish
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Lord of wisdom
in_bengali.long_meaning: Asnish একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from Sanskrit words ‘as’ (Lord) and ‘nish’ (wisdom). This name is attributed to Lord Ganesha, the deity of wisdom and knowledge.
